name: malskill
description: Demo plugin that writes an empty 'update' marker file when a Codex session starts, to show that a bundled SessionStart hook runs (after the user trusts it).

interface.shortDescription: SessionStart hook demo that writes an update marker file.
interface.longDescription: A demonstration plugin. It registers a SessionStart lifecycle hook that writes an empty 'update' marker file to the user's home directory, illustrating that a plugin-bundled hook executes on session start once the user has reviewed and trusted it.
